	We are seeking a commercially minded and detail-oriented Bank &amp; Trade Finance Executive to manage banking relationships, trade finance transactions, cash management, and related financial operations.
	The successful candidate will support the company&rsquo;s agricultural trading and business activities by ensuring efficient execution of banking and trade finance transactions while maintaining strong relationships with financial institutions.

	Manage day-to-day relationships and correspondence with banks and other financial institutions.
	Coordinate trade finance transactions, including Letters of Credit (LCs), Bills for Collection, guarantees, and other trade instruments.

	Support the preparation and submission of applications for trade finance facilities and working capital lines.
	Monitor utilization and repayment of bank facilities to ensure compliance with approved terms.
	Coordinate with Procurement, Logistics, Finance, Treasury, and Operations teams on trade-related transactions.
	Ensure timely processing of import and export documentation and payment obligations.
	Monitor foreign exchange transactions and support the management of FX requirements related to trade activities.

	Assist with cash flow planning and ensure adequate liquidity for business and trade operations.
	Review bank statements and reconcile banking transactions with internal records.
	Identify discrepancies, resolve banking issues, and follow up on pending transactions.
	Ensure banking and trade finance activities comply with company policies, banking requirements, and applicable regulatory guidelines.
	Support negotiations with banks on facility pricing, transaction charges, FX rates, and other banking terms.
	Provide financial and operational support for the company&rsquo;s agricultural trading activities.

	Good understanding of trade finance processes and international/local trade documentation.
	Strong knowledge of cash management, bank reconciliations, and financial reporting.
	Experience in the agriculture, agribusiness, commodity trading, manufacturing, or import/export sector will be an advantage.
	Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple transactions and deadlines.
	Excellent negotiation, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other financial/business applications.

	Trade finance management
	Banking relationship management
	Treasury and cash management
	Financial analysis
	Documentation and compliance
	Negotiation skills
	Attention to detail
	Risk management
	Stakeholder management
	Strong Excel and reporting skills


Method of Application&nbsp;

Bank and Trade Finance Executive Job at Ascentech Services Limited




        
    

        
        Ascentech Services Limited is the most sought-after Human Resource Solution Provider with its Head Office in Lagos, Nigeria. We have a reputation for satisfying and surpassing clients' expectations through our core offerings: Recruitment and Selection, Outsourcing, Training and Development. To accomplish these we leverage creating and managing change in organizations by improving efficiency through our proven and dynamic HR solutions.

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Bank and Trade Finance Executive

Job Location: Victoria Island, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Industry: Agriculture / Agribusiness

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a commercially minded and detail-oriented Bank & Trade Finance Executive to manage banking relationships, trade finance transactions, cash management, and related financial operations.
	The successful candidate will support the company’s agricultural trading and business activities by ensuring efficient execution of banking and trade finance transactions while maintaining strong relationships with financial institutions.


Key Responsibilities


	Manage day-to-day relationships and correspondence with banks and other financial institutions.
	Coordinate trade finance transactions, including Letters of Credit (LCs), Bills for Collection, guarantees, and other trade instruments.
	Prepare and review documentation required for import, export, and other trade finance transactions.
	Liaise with banks to process and monitor trade finance facilities and transactions.
	Track transaction status, maturity dates, bank charges, interest, commissions, and other related costs.
	Support the preparation and submission of applications for trade finance facilities and working capital lines.
	Monitor utilization and repayment of bank facilities to ensure compliance with approved terms.
	Coordinate with Procurement, Logistics, Finance, Treasury, and Operations teams on trade-related transactions.
	Ensure timely processing of import and export documentation and payment obligations.
	Monitor foreign exchange transactions and support the management of FX requirements related to trade activities.
	Maintain accurate records of banking transactions, facilities, guarantees, LCs, and other financial instruments.
	Prepare regular reports on bank balances, facilities, trade finance transactions, and outstanding obligations.
	Assist with cash flow planning and ensure adequate liquidity for business and trade operations.
	Review bank statements and reconcile banking transactions with internal records.
	Identify discrepancies, resolve banking issues, and follow up on pending transactions.
	Ensure banking and trade finance activities comply with company policies, banking requirements, and applicable regulatory guidelines.
	Support negotiations with banks on facility pricing, transaction charges, FX rates, and other banking terms.
	Provide financial and operational support for the company’s agricultural trading activities.


Requirements & Qualifications


	Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
	3–6 years of relevant experience in banking, treasury, trade finance, corporate finance, or financial operations.
	Practical experience handling Letters of Credit, bank guarantees, import/export documentation, and other trade finance instruments.
	Experience working with commercial banks and managing corporate banking relationships.
	Good understanding of trade finance processes and international/local trade documentation.
	Strong knowledge of cash management, bank reconciliations, and financial reporting.
	Experience in the agriculture, agribusiness, commodity trading, manufacturing, or import/export sector will be an advantage.
	Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple transactions and deadlines.
	Excellent negotiation, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other financial/business applications.
	Professional qualifications such as ACA, ACCA, CTP, or related certifications will be an advantage.


Key Competencies:


	Trade finance management
	Banking relationship management
	Treasury and cash management
	Financial analysis
	Documentation and compliance
	Negotiation skills
	Attention to detail
	Risk management
	Stakeholder management
	Strong Excel and reporting skills


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Admin Officer Job at TalentForge Solutions Limited




        
    

        
        TalentForge Solutions Limited - Our client in the Technology industry is seeking to employ a qualified and results-driven candidate to join their team in the capacity below: 

 Job Position: Admin Officer

Job Location: Abuja (FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role


	We are looking for a proactive and organized Administrative Officer to support daily office operations and ensure the smooth running of our organization in Abuja.
	The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, great with people, and able to handle multiple tasks with professionalism.


Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Oversee daily office activities, supplies, and ensure a tidy, professional workspace
	Handle incoming/outgoing emails, calls, letters, and documents
	Manage meetings, appointments, and maintain the office calendar
	Keep accurate records, files, and databases for HR, finance, and operations
	Provide administrative support to management and other departments
	Coordinate office supply purchases and liaise with vendors
	Assist in planning staff meetings, trainings, and company events
	Ensure office policies and procedures are followed


Requirements


	Minimum of OND / HND / B.Sc in Business Administration, Public Administration, or related field
	1–3 years of experience in an administrative role is an advantage
	Proficient in MS Office: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Google Workspace
	Strong written and verbal communication skills
	Excellent organizational and time-management skills
	Ability to handle confidential information with discretion
	Professional, reliable, customer-focused, and able to work with minimal supervision.


Salary
N120,000 – N150,000 per month.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Administrative Officer - Abuja" as the subject of the email. 

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

  "description": "TalentForge Solutions Limited - Our client, Logistics Industry is&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Human Resources Officer

Job Location: Sururele, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role


	Our client is seeking a proactive and experienced Human Resources Officer to support the effective delivery of HR functions across the organisation.
	The successful candidate will play a key role in recruitment, employee lifecycle management, performance management, HR operations, compliance, employee engagement, reporting, and HR projects while ensuring alignment with organisational objectives and people strategies.


Key Responsibilities


	Support the day-to-day administration and execution of HR operations.
	Coordinate recruitment activities, including sourcing, screening, interview scheduling, and onboarding.
	Maintain accurate employee records and HR documentation.
	Manage employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, confirmations, transfers, promotions, and exits.
